C_review_entry.purpose: Actual unique public caller and contracts, copied for human review; not compiled or body-proved by this model package
C_review_entry.entry: int equivalent(size_t mr, size_t nc, size_t kc, const float *a, const float *w, float *left, float *right, const struct xnn_f32_minmax_params *params)

unit_convention.kc: positive byte count, divisible by sizeof(float)=4
unit_convention.K: kc/4 scalar depth elements; K is derived, not an argument
unit_convention.params: pointer to initialized scalar.min/scalar.max floats; lo/hi are logical ghost values, not entry arguments

strides_bytes.scope: standard contiguous rows; arbitrary overlapping row strides are outside this public interface

memory.a: initialized 4*K float cells, including physical inactive rows
memory.w: initialized ceil(nc/8)*8*(K+1) float cells, each panel 8 biases then K groups of 8 weights; last packed panel includes all padding
memory.left_right: each owns writable FloatArray::undef_full(...,4*nc), separated from one another, A/W and params resources; output initialization not required
memory.params: initialized two float fields, scalar.min and scalar.max
memory.active_return: each active mr*nc prefix is initialized full output and compared
memory.unused_return: suffix [mr*nc,4*nc) retains undef permissions; no formal value-preservation assertion for unspecified inactive output contents
memory.input_return: same initialized A/W lists and params field values are restored
memory.alignment: inherited from the actual FloatArray/store predicates and C pointer model; no extra alignment predicate is introduced here

machine_capacity.note: The original pure capacity and SL resource conditions remain; refer to actual C review and Coq definitions.

observation.equality: fp32 numeric equality OR both NaN
observation.lo_hi: arbitrary fp32; no finite-only or lo<=hi restriction
observation.rounding_model: fused RNE, no-flush mathematical intrinsic model; ISA correspondence unproved

memory_model_boundary: QCP underlying memory is byte-based; FloatArray/store_float are typed assertions over it. This package proves the explicit f32 layout/SL lemmas, not arbitrary bytecast or mixed quantized-kernel equivalence.
